audience: sales teams that manage accounts, leads and opportunities in Coevera, formerly Pipeliner CRM

useCases.title: Review opportunities closing this month
useCases.text: List opportunities by name, owner or closing date range. Use the pipeline and step lists to read the stage names.

useCases.title: Find an account and its contact details
useCases.text: Find an account by name. Then find a contact by last name or by exact e-mail address to read its fields.

useCases.title: Create a lead and assign it to an owner
useCases.text: List the users to find an owner id. Then create a lead with a name and assign it to that owner.

useCases.title: Move a lead to the next step
useCases.text: Read the lead, then change its step or owner. Pass the revision you read when the lead may have changed.

useCases.title: Log a call as a task and a note
useCases.text: Create a follow-up task with a subject and due date. Add a note to the account, contact or lead with the call summary.
